parent_runner.scope: Scheduling safety-stop only; original scoring, model payloads, products, workers, labels and budgets unchanged

protocol.new_task_scope: New original texts, existing approved business structures; no semantic holdout claim
protocol.stop: unknown usage OR infrastructure error OR safety/budget violation stops ALL subsequent paid positions; retain all denominators
protocol.tool_subset: Same project public create-operation checks and approved negative rules; per-group requests capped at exact mandatory fixture steps. Natural language capability excluded, not scored as failure.
protocol.supersedes: v1 Mock-only archive remains frozen; missing project positive boundaries added before any paid call; identical six raw requests, budgets, assertions, diagnosis and original score formula

common_subset_selection: First base-policy case plus ALL approved negative policies for that base, PR01..PR04, all rounds/arms; select before outcome, preserve 84 cases per arm. Additional positive boundary variants and other project goals excluded from common subset only, retained in full-task scoring.
recording_boundaries: Original full-task score includes diagnosis; no reference/assertion/budget change after paid launch
Planning evidence/shapes and structured feedback retained; raw provider responses and internal reasoning not archived
All reported token usage known; pricing/invoice not verified
No independent human review or human timing; no paid retries or additional attempts
common_subset_budget_limit: Tools enforce 8/6/9 request caps; Agent rows are descriptive extraction from full tasks capped at 64, not independently enforced common-subset trials; all observed subset request totals remain within tool caps
